Made for a quick break. Stay for a good move.

Make a bigger universe.

Tap one of the five lanes or cells. Your next planet falls into it. Touching planets with the same number merge into the next number.

Merges can start a chain reaction. The more matches in a chain, the more points you earn. Keep room at the top!

Boosters & Missions

You earn free undos and shuffles as you clear orbital milestones and daily check-ins. Paid boosters are optional and keep your high score run alive.

A fair little game

There are no cash prizes or tokens. New games are always free. Daily Challenge mode is identical for all players worldwide with zero paid boosters.

Your data

Practice progress stays in this browser. In Telegram, identity is verified on the server before purchases. Payment records and paid boosters are kept to deliver purchases and resolve support requests.

Payment help: /paysupport in the game bot.
